svg.title: Health-Info-Card device and data-flow architecture
svg.desc: AI Passport Senior Safety Card (Health-Info-Card): ESP32-C3 firmware architecture, on-device storage partitions, and the local Wi-Fi setup data flow.
svg.text: AI Passport Senior Safety Card — Device & Data-Flow Architecture
图注：设备与数据流架构（基于仓库实际实现绘制）· Drawn from the actual firmware implementation · ESP-IDF 5.5.3 / ESP32-C3 / 240×320 ST7789
DEVICE — wearable card (ESP32-C3)
Hardware (components/bsp)
Display: ST7789 240×320 portrait RGB565 (SPI2 40 MHz, no PSRAM)
Input: UP / DOWN / OK via ADC resistor ladder on GPIO0
Audio: ES8311 (I2S0) · Battery: CW2017 (I2C0 shared bus)
USB-Serial-JTAG console + FAP screenshot / key-injection protocol
Flash partitions (partitions.csv)
factory app — 3 MB (full firmware, boot)
protected cardid @ 0x356000 — device identity
permanent Recovery @ 0x700000 (hold UP 5 s to enter)
imgstore
128 KB / 4 slots
WeChat QR JPEGs
NVS — profile · PIN hash
App profile: name / age / blood type / contacts / address / health notes (versioned struct, demo flag)
Application (main/)
ui_safety.c — 5 display pages + full-screen QR · safety_portal.c — local setup portal
safety_profile.c / safety_store.c — profile & PIN (salt + SHA-256 only)
jpeg_store.c / jpeg_view.c — QR images · pin_throttle.c — 5 fails → 60 s lock
fap_screenshot.c — on-device acceptance over USB-Serial-JTAG
PHONE / FAMILY — setup & reading
First setup (portal, local hotspot only)
1. Scan the Wi-Fi QR shown by the device on first boot
2. Join the password-protected hotspot, open http://192.168.4.1
3. Fill in the safety profile and upload up to 4 WeChat QR codes
(family / backup / community-doctor / other; 28 KB max per image)
4. Save → profile sealed to NVS, QR JPEGs to imgstore, Wi-Fi off
Daily use (fully offline)
UP / DOWN page through 5 pages; OK shows a QR full screen
Long-press OK re-opens setup (PIN required after configuration)
60 s without input → deep sleep; any function key wakes
A stranger or passer-by can read the card without any app
Privacy & safety boundary
Profile stays in NVS; QR images stay in imgstore — nothing is uploaded
PIN stored as salt + SHA-256 digest; brute force throttled on the portal
Wi-Fi + local web server run only during setup; BLE disabled in normal use
Full address is opt-in; phone numbers are masked by default
Not a medical device — it does not replace emergency services or care
hotspot + portal (192.168.4.1)
saved profile + QR
→ NVS + imgstore, Wi-Fi off
